title: MOTION (JURADO - HUTT) relative to waiving the fees for Parking Lot 7, located at 140 North Judge John Aiso Street, for election workers and voters involved…
text:
[Council File 26-1457; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (JURADO - HUTT) relative to waiving the fees for Parking Lot 7, located at 140 North Judge John Aiso Street, for election workers and voters involved with the November 3, 2026 General Election.
Recommendation for Council action:
AUTHORIZE the Department of General Services to waive the fees at Parking Lot 7, located at 140 North Judge John Aiso Street, between Temple Street and First Street, for the November 3, 2026 General Election for election workers and voters during the following dates and times:
October 31, 2026; 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
November 1, 2026; 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
November 2, 2026; 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
November 3, 2026; 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
summary: Waives parking fees at Parking Lot 7 near City Hall for election workers and voters during the days leading up to the November 3, 2026 General Election.

locations.text: 140 N Judge John Aiso St, Los Angeles, CA

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026); Council action final
